exercises.why: From Wiktionary: роди́ть — to give birth; рожде́ние — birth; роди́тель — parent; ро́дина — homeland, motherland, native land.
**родину** — ро́дина: homeland, motherland, native land; (affectionate, usually capitalized) Russia as the Motherland; (affectionate, dated, usually capitalized) the Soviet Union.
